events.description: A run was opened and its journal chain began; the header meta record follows.
The run's lifecycle state changed (for example open, running, or closed).
A checkpoint snapshot of run state was recorded as a restore accelerator, never as truth.
Run state was restored from its journal, by full replay or snapshot-assisted restore.
The run finished; its journal is sealed and a receipt is issued.
A record was appended to the run journal by the single journal writer.
The journal was recovered: a torn tail was truncated and the chain re-sealed, as an auditable event.
The journal hash chain was verified end-to-end without finding a break.
The run's closing receipt was computed from its journal and sealed into it.
A broker decision (allow, deny, or prompt) was journaled; decide precedes act.
A durable human gate was opened and the run paused awaiting human authority.
A human resolved a durable gate; the answer is journaled and authoritative.
A human approval elevated a prompt decision into an authorized action; the elevation is journaled and audited.
A broker evaluation, allow or deny, was appended to the hash-chained audit ledger.
A research capability (name, declared sources, fencing) was declared before use.
The research index was updated from declared local sources.
Content was retrieved from a declared source and stored in the blob store under its blake3 digest.
An evidence record was built from a fenced block with mandatory provenance and a blob_ref.
A research context was assembled from provenance-carrying, fenced content.
A model invocation completed through the gateway single gate; the payload carries usage, integer micro-USD cost, attempts, latency, the redacted assembled text, and the broker decision link.
A model invocation failed after its broker decision (secret unresolved, breaker open, transport refusal, budget stop); the payload carries the error code and the decision link.
A tool invocation was requested and submitted for broker evaluation.
A broker-approved tool invocation completed and returned its result.
A tool invocation was refused by the broker and the denial was journaled.
A supervised agent run began over journaled decisions; the payload carries the goal, planner kind, and step ceiling.
One agent step (model invocation, tool call, note, or context pack) completed; the payload links the step to its decisions and carries usage when model-backed.
An agent step failed after its retries; the payload carries the error code and the step coordinates.
The agent run reached an outcome (goal, step_limit, failed, or awaiting_gate); every journaled step remains replayable.
A deterministic workflow DAG execution began; the payload carries the workflow id and node count.
A workflow node began executing after its dependencies completed.
A workflow node completed; its output is content-addressed in the blob store and referenced by blob_ref.
A workflow node failed after its retries; the payload carries the error code.
The workflow DAG finished; the payload summarizes completed and failed nodes for deterministic resume.
A scratchpad note was appended to the run's persistent reasoning session.
Older scratchpad notes were folded into a deterministic summary checkpoint; the fold is recomputable from the journal alone.
An extension artifact was digest-verified and spawned by the host; the payload names the extension and the pinned digest.
A spawned extension process exited; the payload carries the exit code (or signal).
Content was stored in the blake3 content-addressed blob store; the payload carries the blob_ref.
A .vxn bundle was built as a deterministic fold over declared inputs; the payload carries the bundle blake3 digest, entry count, and byte size.
A .vxn bundle was verified as a pure check (digests recomputed, pins compared; content never executed); the payload carries the outcome and the bundle blake3 digest.
